title: hieracium laevigatum subsp. dryadeum
intro: Hieracium laevigatum subsp. dryadeum, commonly known as Hawkweed, is a flowering plant species within the dandelion-like Hawkweed genus. It is known to have various health benefits, such as its antioxidant properties, which can help protect against cell damage and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Hawkweed include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it a potential treatment for wounds and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Hawkweed include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
